head: codex/5338-v0918-wp05-deterministic-compiler
title: [v0.91.8][WP-05] Add pure deterministic compiler
body:
Closes #5338

Adds an independent pure Rust compiler from validated adl-language documents to a versioned inert ExecutionPlan. It deterministically resolves workflows, tasks, agents, providers, models, effective tools, declared ports, prompts, saved-state dependencies, and provenance; uses lexical graph ordering and canonical JSON; enforces construction-time graph and aggregate input bounds; and generates explicit node_v1 identities from canonical effective node semantics.

All nineteen landed characterization fixtures are mechanically classified with fail-on-new-fixture behavior. Legacy patterns remain explicitly outside the compiler boundary because the landed language model rejects them. FastWork proof passes 18 tests including JSON/YAML permutations, clean subprocess plan and diagnostic replay, stable-identity locality and golden vectors, strict Clippy, exact five-package COTS guards, 577 implementation and 519 test/fixture lines, and all declared time ceilings. Bounded exact-revision review passes with no actionable findings after remediation. No Runtime v2, AWS, scheduling, retry, provider invocation, I/O, control-plane, database, selector, or migration authority was added.
